newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY O/N RATES CALM, END AT 21.5 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY O/N RATES CALM, END AT 21.5 PCT.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates calmed down on Monday after Friday's surge ahead of Monday's tax payment deadline.
O/N rates opened at between 21.5 and 22 percent and ended at 21.5 percent. Friday saw rates rise to as high as 24 percent before falling back to 21.5 to 22 percent.
"There was no repeat of Friday's brief panic," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank. "We started in a wide range of 21.5 to 22 percent, with a taken at 22, and ended at 21.5 percent."
Szatmari saw the tom/next rates at a similar level of around 21.5 percent. -- Budapest newsroom (361) 327 4040
